name: editor
title: Editor
description: The frame of a rich text editor: its toolbar, its document and their states.
use: Formatted text a reader writes: a description, a comment, a post. The editing itself, the document model, the selection, the history and the keys, belongs to an engine such as TipTap or ProseMirror, which makes editor-document editable and writes the classes of its blocks; the editor draws the frame, the toolbar band, the states and what the document holds. For plain text, a textarea is simpler and better.

instead.when: The text is plain, or a few lines without formatting
It is a message or a prompt sent with a button, which grows from one line
The text is read, not edited

keyboard.action: Moves from the toolbar, one stop, to the document and on; the engine decides whether Tab indents a list item
In the toolbar: move between its controls, as the toolbar behavior does
In the document: the engine's shortcuts for bold, italic, underline, undo and redo

platform.feature: contenteditable, made editable by the engine
platform.fallback: Without the engine the frame and its states still draw: a document with contenteditable edits as the browser's own contenteditable does, without structure, and the toolbar does nothing
The frame does not rise or take the danger edge with the document's focus and state; the document itself still shows them

classes.name: editor
classes.description: The frame: the well of a field that holds the toolbar band and the document, and rises with the document's focus

classes.name: editor-toolbar
classes.description: On a toolbar at the top of the frame: laid flat, one inset in, with a hairline under it; it wraps on a narrow editor

classes.name: editor-document
classes.description: The element the engine makes editable: it grows from --editor-rows lines to --editor-max-rows, then scrolls. Name it with aria-labelledby, and describe it with the field's hint

classes.name: editor-heading
classes.description: A heading of the document, on an h2 or the level the engine writes

classes.name: editor-subheading
classes.description: A heading a level below editor-heading

classes.name: editor-list
classes.description: A list with bullets, its markers in the muted ink; a list inside an item takes circles

classes.name: editor-list-numbered
classes.description: Numbers instead of bullets, on an ol

classes.name: editor-quote
classes.description: A quotation, on a blockquote: a rule at its start and its words a step quieter

classes.name: editor-link
classes.description: A link in the document, underlined in the line's ink

classes.name: editor-rule
classes.description: A horizontal rule between parts of the document

states.name: focus
states.description: The frame rises to a raised face with the field's focus halo

states.name: invalid
states.description: The frame takes the danger edge, and a field-error in the field shows

states.name: read only
states.description: The frame rests flat with no caret: the words can be read and copied, not changed

states.name: disabled
states.description: The frame keeps its well, as a disabled input does, and takes disabled ink; disable the toolbar's controls and the engine with it

properties.name: --editor-rows
properties.description: How many lines the document shows when it is empty

properties.name: --editor-max-rows
properties.description: How many lines it grows to before it scrolls
